illager_tongue.jaymoskingdoms.step: You can make out more of the illager tongue: %s
illager_tongue.jaymoskingdoms.learned.ba: The banner's marks make more sense now. Illager tongue: %s
illager_tongue.jaymoskingdoms.learned.pa: You pick out the words painted in. Illager tongue: %s
illager_tongue.jaymoskingdoms.read.known: Nothing in this you don't already know.
illager_tongue.jaymoskingdoms.study.star: You crouch and study the banner...
illager_tongue.jaymoskingdoms.study.done: You've already learned what the banner can teach.
illager_tongue.jaymoskingdoms.study.noth: You know more of the tongue than the banner can teach.
illager_tongue.jaymoskingdoms.study.star: You crouch and study the painting...
illager_tongue.jaymoskingdoms.study.done: You've already learned what the painting can teach.
illager_tongue.jaymoskingdoms.study.noth: You know more of the tongue than the painting can teach.
illager_tongue.jaymoskingdoms.chatter.pi: The warlord wants the iron by nightfall.
Keep your eyes on the road. They come at dusk now.
My crossbow string is fraying again.
The greenskins took the works. We should take them back.
Another tower lost to the bandits. Another.
illager_tongue.jaymoskingdoms.chatter.vi: We filled the sky raiders' boots. We can fill a few graves too.
The villagers grow bold. Bold makes good sport.
Who left the gate open? Who?
I smell a farmer. A farmer and fear.
The old holds stand empty. Shame.
illager_tongue.jaymoskingdoms.chatter.ev: The old marks still answer, if you speak them right.
Keep your voices down. The fangs listen.
Bring me what the dead leave behind.
The banner remembers who carried it.
Our words are older than their kings.
illager_tongue.jaymoskingdoms.chatter.wa: Hold the walls. No one leaves until I say.
We pulled back. We did not run.
Bring me the iron and bring me the captives.
The world is being taken back, they say. Let them try.
painting.jaymoskingdoms.illager_raid.aut: A war band behind its banner, painted by one who rode with it.
A seated warlord with the banner over his head.
painting.jaymoskingdoms.illager_rite.aut: Evokers calling up fangs from the ground.
painting.jaymoskingdoms.illager_glyphs.a: Their letters, painted large, as a lesson.
painting.jaymoskingdoms.illager_march.au: A column of them on the road at dusk.
painting.jaymoskingdoms.illager_banner.a: Their banner, with its words written round it.
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.head: %s · %s · %s · %s
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.too_little: You don't know enough of the illager tongue to talk with them. %s
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.parley.calm: Calm them: no one needs to bleed today
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.parley.bluff: Bluff: you were sent, and others are close behind
Bluff (you need a better command of their tongue)
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.round.bluff: Bluff: claim to speak for their warlord
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.round.bluff_: Bluff (you need a better command of their tongue)
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.166: Illagers have a tongue of their own. Study their torn pages, ledgers and grimoires, crouch before their banners and paintings, and spend time in their old holds; once you know enough, sneak and use on one to talk. Knowing their words won't make them friendly.
You had your say. Now steel.
Talk? You struck one of us.
Talk fast. My axe is bored.
Say it before I split you.
You want words? Make them short.
Words cost. What have you got?
Stop. Maybe you are worth more alive.
Speak, and show me your purse.
You dare speak our tongue to me?
Kneel, then speak.
An outsider with our words. Amusing. Go on.
Interesting. Why would you learn our words?
Speak. I'm listening for the lie.
Clever. Too clever. Talk.
The old marks did not teach you for nothing. Speak.
Your words are stolen. Say them anyway.
Speak, before the fangs do.
Hold. I'm tired of this. What do you want?
Another fight. Or not. Say it.
Speak. My arms are heavy today.
You speak our words... that is an omen. Of what?
Who taught you? Speak!
A stranger with our tongue. Bad luck, or good?
W-wait! Talk first!
Stay back. Say what you want.
I'll listen! Just keep that blade down.
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.line.greet.c: The outsider with our words. What is it?
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.line.greet.f: Good to see a face that speaks properly.
Lower it, all of you. Let this one be.
Hm. You talk well. Go in peace, for now.
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.line.not_cal: You talk like a farmer. Die like one.
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.line.paid.0: Coin talks. Pass, and don't look back.
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.line.paid.1: Paid is paid. Nobody touches this one today.
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.line.paid.2: Good. Now we are friends until sunrise.
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.line.bluffed: More of you coming? Then go, before I think on it.
Hm. Fine. I don't want trouble from above.
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.line.bluff_s: You think I'm a fool? Blades!
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.line.go.0: Go. Before I change my mind.
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.line.name_no: Names are for those we trust.
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.line.chat.br: You want to know a good axe? Weight in the head. Always.
I broke a door with my shoulder once. Still hurts. Worth it.
A clean fight is a short one. I like short.
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.line.chat.gr: Everything has a price. Even this talk. Lucky for you, it's free today.
I keep a coin from every raid. Never spend them.
Gold is honest. People are not.
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.line.chat.pr: We built these holds. Every stone.
Our banners flew where kings would not go.
Remember: we filled the sky raiders' place. Nobody else could.
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.line.chat.cu: The trick is to let them think they won.
Watch the road, not the walls. The road tells you everything.
I hear things. I keep most of them.
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.line.chat.ze: The marks on our banners are older than any kingdom.
The evokers say the old words still have teeth.
Do you feel it? The ground listens here.
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.line.chat.we: I've been marching since I was a boy. My knees know it.
Some days I think of a field. Just a field.
Sit. Rest. There's always another fight tomorrow.
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.line.chat.su: Never step over a dropped banner. Bad luck for a year.
A black cat crossed the road this morning. I stayed in.
The moon was red last week. Something's coming.
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.line.chat.cr: Between you and me, I hate the front of a raid.
I'd rather guard the stores. Stores don't bite.
Don't tell the warlord I talked to you.
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.line.chat.so: I've nothing to say to you.
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.line.want_no: I have what I need. For now.
You already brought me something. That's enough.
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.line.want.1: Bring me %s and we'll talk properly.
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.line.want_me: You remembered! Here, take this. And this.
That's it. That's the one. You have my thanks.
Hah! An outsider who keeps their word. Take these.
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.line.coin.2: That buys you a little goodwill.
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.line.liked.2: You know what we like. Interesting.
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.line.trade.0: What do you want? I have a few things.
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.line.trade.2: Look, but don't touch until you pay.
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.line.sold.0: Yours. Don't use it on us.
That will make a few bolts.
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.line.hold.no: I have no hold. I walk with the patrol.
Our camp? Gone. We are what's left.
No walls for me. Only the road.
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.line.hold.mi: This hold is mine. Every stone and every soul.
I lead here. That's all you need to know.
Ask me about my hold? You're standing in it.
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.line.hold.le: Our warlord is %s. You don't want to meet them angry.
No one leads us now. It shows.
The warlord fell. We hold on anyway.
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.line.hold.ca: There are %s we took. Don't get ideas.
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.line.hold.ot: Go %s, %s, and you'll find more of us.
Our kin keep a hold %s of here. %s.
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.line.round.p: Hm. You make sense. For an outsider.
Fine, fine. For you, a better price today.
That's not how we do things.
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.line.round.b: The warlord said that? Then... here, take his orders. I don't need them.
Ah. I didn't know. Here, this is yours then.
Right, right. Take this and go.
Lies. I know what the warlord says.
illager_talk.jaymoskingdoms.line.round.t: You threaten me? In my own hold?
